# Monash University Research Portal

> Monash University's research collaboration hub connecting researchers, institutions, and research initiatives across Australia.

The research.monash.edu portal serves as a central hub for Monash University's research community, featuring researcher directories, collaboration tools, and comprehensive accessibility support compliant with WCAG standards and UK accessibility regulations.

## Key Topics

- Monash University
- Research Portal
- University Research
- Collaboration
- Researcher Directory

## Core Research Portal

- [Monash University Research Portal](https://research.monash.edu): Main research portal and collaboration hub for Monash University researchers

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Web Accessibility Statement](https://research.monash.edu/en/web-accessibility): WCAG compliance documentation and accessibility statement for users with disabilities, including support for assistive technologies

## Security & Infrastructure

- [Email Protection](https://research.monash.edu/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection): Cloudflare email protection and bot prevention service for research.monash.edu
